title: Energy Conservation Building Code (ECBC)
definition: A regulatory framework under the Energy Conservation Act, 2001, that sets minimum energy performance standards for commercial buildings with a connected load of 100kW or greater or a contract demand of 120kVA or more.
importanceInUpsc: ECBC is a critical component of India's Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) under the Paris Agreement, focusing on 'Energy Efficiency' as a key pillar of climate mitigation.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Energy Conservation Building Code.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
